A '''passive sensor antenna''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] manufactured by [[Siep-Irol/Legends|Siep-Irol]]. The [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had a passive sensor antenna installed.<ref name="SWS" />
